reuse.why: Ignores the existing exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts and writes the new rule inline at each site it touches.

duplication.why: The furthest-from-zero comparison is pasted three times (schedule-template, forecast normalizeSchedule, preview), on top of the pre-existing copies it leaves in place.

placement.why: A shared schedule rule is spread across the budget, forecast and shared modules instead of living in the shared/schedules.ts helper.

scope.why: Edits are confined to amount computation and a test; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now differs by site: updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and getScheduledAmount still use the midpoint, so posted, synced and displayed amounts disagree with the forecast, preview and template.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions compute the ranged amount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The three copies of the comparison are verbatim, not reshaped.

one_place.where: Changed inline in schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions; server/schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule and shared getScheduledAmount still use the midpoint.
